description: Traces the gods’ labor dispute, creation of humanity, escalating plagues and famine, Atrahasis’s survival of the flood and the negotiated reproductive limits that follow. Examines divine dependence on human labor and offerings, the limits of authority, fragmentary Old Babylonian witnesses, and the differing literary and theological roles of the flood in Atrahasis, Gilgamesh and Genesis.
